name: team_planning_rebase_preview
description: Preview updating a Team Planning plan the caller is in to today (a UTC day), before team_planning_rebase_plan does it. The drift being taken in is what team_planning_drift lists. For the baseline (scenario_id equal to the plan_id) and each scenario, it counts the planned changes reading done, pending and conflicting, as team_planning_status reads them. Once the base is today a conflicting change would read pending, so `conflicts` names each one, by the scenario it reads conflicting in, subject_id, facet and change_id: the update records them afresh, and status keeps them conflicting. Pass base_on to team_planning_rebase_plan. Refused when the plan already stands on today or on a day still to come, and, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
